title: Access, and possibly experience, need counterfactual self-modeling

statements.text: Conscious access, and possibly phenomenal consciousness, likely requires generative processes that can model counterfactuals about the self and its own actions, since causal inference is needed to bring coherence to an experienced world.

sources.quote: Conscious access—and possibly phenomenal consciousness—likely requires generative processes capable of counterfactual modeling
IWMT does claim that counterfactual processing may be required for consciousness via the causal inferences it affords
